values.note: Book online on the campground's Park With Us page ('CLICK HERE TO BOOK NOW') or by phone/text; full payment at booking. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am; call if arriving after 4 pm. Seasonal sites by waiting list.

note: Private family campground on wooded acreage near Wolverine with aspen groves, nature trails and ATV trail access; large pool, general store, pavilion. Daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal camping. --Claude
summary: Operator site + Park With Us booking page: $45 W/E to $50 full hookup (plus tax), 20/30/50 A, water at every site, sewer at the full-hookup pull-throughs, showers/laundry/store/dump, no campground wifi; phone 231-445-0801 matches (Google Maps 4.8 / 120 reviews). Added season May 1 - Nov 1, engine url. Changed sites count 65 -> 92 (booking engine's site list), max length 60 ft. Note cleaned of hookup/site/price/booking text the fields hold.
flags: Seasonal share: the booking engine lists 92 RV/tent sites but only 21 are bookable online (the other 71 are presumably seasonal; the site sells $1,800-2,000 seasonals by waiting list), so the park is mostly seasonal by count (~77%). It passes test 2 (posted $45 nightly rate, online booking) and test 4 (21 of 92, about 23%, sold nightly).
Price gate: base $45 + tax (W/E), under US$50; no gateway within 40 km (Mackinaw City 63 km); the family has not stayed here.
